title: AkcliDrawResult
description: akcli plan/draw --json: per-op results + connectivity findings + the before/after net diff. 'applied' is true only when --apply was given AND every op succeeded AND connectivity verified; a dry run reports the same net_diff the real apply would produce. Consumers must tolerate additive growth.

net_diff.description: The before/after net-membership delta: 'lines' holds one human-readable string per change, most severe first — '! SPLIT' / '! MERGE', then 'MOVE <pins>: <from> -> <to>' for a minority pin group that left one net for another ('!' when a named net is involved, else '~'), then '~' modified / '= RENAME' / '+ NEW' / '- GONE'; 'risk' is true when a split, merge or move touches a named net (the --strict-nets gate).

preview.description: Present when --render OUT.svg was given and the dry-apply succeeded: the WOULD-BE sheet rendered to SVG before anything touches the target. null when not requested or when the (non-fatal) render failed.

project_root.description: Present ONLY when the net gate evaluated a sheet TREE (the target is a child of a hierarchy): posix path of the resolved root schematic. Absent — not null — on the flat single-file path.

evaluation_scope.description: Present alongside project_root: the net diff and preview were computed over the whole sheet tree, not the target file alone.

run_id.description: Present ONLY on a multi-sheet (envelope 'sheets'/per-op 'sheet') run: the transaction id — recorded in the journal, named by `akcli undo --run`. Absent on the single-file path.

files.description: Present alongside run_id: one entry per file the transaction loaded. 'written' is true only after a committed --apply.
